PRIVACY NOTICE

Respect for your
information.

A straightforward explanation of this website’s functionality.

Inquiries

The firm uses the contact details and message you submit to respond to your enquiry. The current submission method is explained alongside the form. Contact office@psbassociates.in with questions about information you send to the firm.

Online enquiry protection and delivery

When online submission is enabled, the form sends your name, email address, selected service and message to Web3Forms for delivery to the firm. A confirmation page appears only after Web3Forms accepts your enquiry. If online submission is unavailable, the form remains disabled. Please do not include confidential financial records.

Analytics preferences

If Google Analytics is enabled, it loads only after you choose Allow analytics. It measures page visits and successful enquiry submissions. Form contents, names and email addresses are not sent to Analytics. Your choice is saved in your browser and can be changed through Analytics preferences in the footer. Analytics may use cookies and process device and usage information through Google.

Your information

The website does not maintain a database of enquiries. Messages sent to the firm are handled in its mailbox and by its email provider. To ask about access, correction, deletion or retention of an enquiry, contact office@psbassociates.in. Applicable professional or recordkeeping obligations may affect whether a message can be deleted.

External services

Google Maps is embedded on the contact page, and typefaces load from Google Fonts. These providers may receive your IP address and browser information when their content loads. Official resource links open third-party sites with their own privacy practices.

Confidential information

Please do not send confidential financial records or identity documents through a general website inquiry. Appropriate arrangements can be discussed directly with the firm.
